---
name: FR.APL.02 draft preservation
description: Why restoring drafts must retain the original AI-generated competency units, not fetch new ones.
---

Keep the competency unit list together with the user's answers when saving or resuming an FR.APL.02 draft. Returning from the profile step must not regenerate units for an unchanged jabatan.

**Why:** Competency units are generated by AI rather than a fixed catalog. A new request may return different codes or ordering, so restoring only answer text can lose or misassign the user's evidence.

**How to apply:** Any future account-based draft storage or changes to step navigation must retain the exact unit snapshot and its answer associations.
